summary.title: Port structure.redundancy + stdlib precision fix
summary.what: Ported structure.redundancy as a Module-altitude REVIEW@WARNING verdict (one per sibling pair sharing >= min_shared project callees). Forwarded min_shared/min_score through view.redundant_siblings. Registry 17; 4 tests.

decisions.point: How to fix the stdlib false-positive
decisions.chose: Restrict shared callees to project-defined names via a corpus-wide callable_names context index
decisions.rationale: Language-agnostic, no hardcoded stdlib list; the redundancy signal is about shared *project* helpers, so non-project callees (stdlib methods) are correctly excluded.
rejected: Hardcode a stdlib-method noise list (fragile, per-language)

decisions.rationale: Confident overlap but disjunctive remedy (extract/merge/accept) — same shape as call-islands.
rejected: Directed EXTRACT_HELPER verdict (overlap is more speculative than Type-2 clones)
